geometry.note: OSM building footprint (rank 11) caps confidence at approximate, though its identification as the Tsukuba straight section is corroborated by the SuperKEKB accelerator paper's own Figure 1 (rank 10).

method: OpenStreetMap building footprint way 560183492, name '筑波実験棟' / 'Tsukuba area', used verbatim.
name: KEK Tsukuba experimental hall (Belle II)
notes: Represents site:kek-tsukuba-belle-ii, which hosts detector:belle and detector:belle-ii.

SuperKEKB's four straight sections are named Tsukuba, Oho, Fuji and Nikko in Fig. 1 of src:superkekb-collider-nima-2018 ('The electron and positron beams collide at the interaction point in the Tsukuba straight section.'); the other three are drawn as context buildings below (geometry:kek-oho-hall, geometry:kek-fuji-hall, geometry:kek-nikko-hall).

summary.plain: The experimental hall at KEK's Tsukuba straight section where the Belle and Belle II detectors have recorded electron-positron collisions.
